summary: iter-329 Sinus Lift Pre-Op Briefing PDF + procedure-type reorder — 17/17 backend tests PASS (7 new in test_preop_briefing.py + 10 existing in test_sinus_lift.py after reorder assertion update). PDF generation works end-to-end: 200 application/pdf, attachment; filename=\"PreOp_SinusLift_*\", >3KB body, %PDF- magic OK. PDF text (via pypdf) contains: 'Pre-Operative Briefing', patient name, age, sex, sinus_lift_type, bone-graft text, supervisor name, in-charge name, 'upper back teeth', '60 to 90', 'Do not blow your nose', 'Healing timeline', 'urgently', 'Cost & next steps' — and is correctly free of any 'signature' string. Direct variant contains 'tiny window on the side of your cheekbone' + 'less than about 5 mm' and NOT 'gentler approach'; Indirect contains 'about 5 - 8 mm'/'gentler approach' and NOT the Direct phrases. Negative paths: non-Sinus-Lift returns 400 with the exact spec detail; unknown id returns 404; no Authorization header returns 401/403. Audit log entry pdf_export/preop_briefing recorded with correct resource_id. GET /api/case-form-options procedure_types matches the new exact order (Sinus Lift between Immediate Implant and Partial Extraction Therapy). Case-report PDF for the same Sinus Lift case still passes — no regression.

integration_issues.flow: Case Detail action row on freshly-created (Draft) cases
integration_issues.issue: PRE-OP BRIEFING button (data-testid='preop-briefing-btn') is NOT in the DOM on a fresh Draft-state Sinus Lift case. The sibling EXPORT/PRINT button (data-testid='case-report-export-print-btn') is ALSO not in the DOM on the same draft case — so the entire action row is gated by case status, not by the new conditional. This is the EXISTING app behaviour (canExportPDF() / draft gating), not a regression from iter-329. The new button's conditional (`procedure.implant_procedure_type === 'Sinus Lift' && canExportPDF()`) is wired the same way as EXPORT/PRINT, so once a case is past Draft and the action row renders, the button will inherit the same visibility correctly (main agent already verified this manually). Could not progress a Draft case past Phase 1 via API alone within this run.

action_items: Main agent self-test: open an existing non-Draft Sinus Lift case (or one that has been submitted past Phase 1) as Abhijit.patil and confirm visually that the green PRE-OP BRIEFING button appears alongside EXPORT/PRINT and that it does NOT appear on a non-Sinus-Lift case in the same status — main agent already reported manual confirmation.

Optional: lower the gating so the PRE-OP BRIEFING button is visible from Draft state, since the briefing is intended to be 'handed to the patient at scheduling' — currently the patient cannot get the briefing until the case advances past Draft. This is a product-decision call, not a bug.

rca of the issue: No backend or PDF bug. The UI button could not be observed via Playwright because freshly-created procedures via POST /api/procedures land in Draft state, and the Case Detail screen hides the action row (which contains both EXPORT/PRINT and PRE-OP BRIEFING) until the case is past Draft. This is existing app behaviour predating iter-329. The new button's conditional is correctly wired in the same gated container as EXPORT/PRINT and was already manually verified by the main agent on a non-Draft case.
